name: So Delicious Dairy-Free Vanilla Bean Coconutmilk Frozen Dessert
whyItWorks: Made from certified organic coconut milk, pure cane sugar, and Madagascar vanilla bean specks. 100% dairy-free, lactose-free, soy-free, and gluten-free; velvety mouthfeel that soothes inflamed throats and guts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Let sit on the counter for 3 minutes before scooping for optimum silky creaminess.
